one_line: The paper designs, validates, and implements a low-cost soft sensor to estimate the gas flow consumed by a 750 kW utility gas boiler at an EDF R&D site, for energy-consumption monitoring in the general manufacturing sector; it does not apply to any continuous-flow Corpus B production process.
